machineDrafts.name: MTC-420
machineDrafts.description:
The MTC-420 is a two-axis slant-bed CNC lathe with a 45-degree slant bed of cast iron, 12-station turret, and MC-8T control. It is intended for turning, drilling, and threading of metal workpieces (steel, cast iron, aluminium, brass) in industrial use.

Main components include a ribbed cast iron bed with roller linear guides, main spindle with A2-6 nose and 15 kW AC motor, servo turret with 12 stations (VDI 30), hydraulic tailstock quill, hydraulic unit, central grease lubrication system, coolant system, hinged belt chip conveyor, and an electrical cabinet.

Operating limits include a maximum turning diameter of 420 mm, maximum turning length of 600 mm, bar capacity of 52 mm, spindle speed range of 30 to 4,500 rpm, hydraulic system pressure of 35 bar nominal, and ambient operating temperature of 10 to 35 °C.

machineDrafts.name: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump
machineDrafts.description:
The pump set is intended for pumping clean or slightly contaminated water without solids larger than 2 mm, at 5 to 60 °C, in the flow range of chapter 4. It is designed for continuous operation in industrial cooling and process water systems.

Main parts include a volute casing (axial suction nozzle, radial discharge nozzle pointing upwards), casing cover, shaft, closed impeller, grease-lubricated bearing frame housing two deep groove ball bearings (drive end 6309-C3, non-drive end 6308-C3), mechanical seal, casing and casing cover wear rings, flexible spacer coupling, and an 18.5 kW 2-pole motor.

Main operating limits include an allowed flow range of 35 to 140 m³/h, duty point of 110 m³/h at 46 m head, maximum casing pressure of 16 bar at 20 °C, liquid temperature between 5 and 60 °C (trip above 70 °C), and a maximum start frequency of 6 times per hour.

machineDrafts.name: RSV-37 (variable speed drive)
machineDrafts.description:
Supplies compressed air at 7 bar to the production hall: pneumatic tools, actuators, and blow-off nozzles.

Twin-screw air end with oil injection, 37 kW permanent magnet motor with frequency converter, oil separator vessel, air-cooled oil cooler and aftercooler, electronic condensate drain, AirLogic 5 controller.

The motor drives the air end directly. Air enters through the air filter and the inlet valve and is compressed between the two rotors. Injected oil seals, cools, and lubricates the rotors. The separator vessel removes the oil from the air; the oil returns through the oil cooler and the oil filter. The minimum pressure valve keeps at least 4 bar in the vessel for the oil circulation. The VSD changes the motor speed to hold the setpoint pressure.

statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Spindle overtemperature: The spindle bearing temperature is above 70 °C. Let the spindle cool down to below 45 °C. Check the belt tension and the spindle cooling fins. If the alarm comes back within 1 week, have the spindle bearings inspected by Morvane service.
Hydraulic pressure low: The hydraulic pressure is below 25 bar. The chuck clamping is not safe; the spindle cannot start. Check the oil level, the pressure setting (35 bar), and the hoses for leaks.
Hydraulic return filter clogged: The filter indicator switched. Replace the return filter element MV-420-2210 within 1 week.
Hydraulic oil overtemperature: The oil temperature is above 65 °C. The hydraulic unit stops; the chuck stays clamped by the check valve. Let the oil cool down and find the cause before the restart.
Spindle speed deviation: The actual speed differs by more than 10 % from the set speed for 2 s. Check the belt for slip and the spindle encoder cable.
Spindle overload: The spindle load was above 120 % for more than 10 s. Reduce the depth of cut or the feed rate. Check the insert for wear; a blunt insert raises the load by 20 to 40 %.
Spindle vibration too high: The vibration is above 7.1 mm/s. The spindle stops. Do not restart before the cause is found: loose chuck, damaged bearing, loose belt pulley.
Spindle drive fault: The spindle drive reported a fault. Read the drive code on the diagnosis screen (alarm manual MC8T-ALM-EN).
Spindle vibration high: The vibration is above 4.5 mm/s. Check the balance of the chuck and the workpiece and the clamping of long workpieces. Plan a vibration analysis if the value stays high.
Hydraulic oil temperature high: The oil temperature is above 55 °C. Check the oil level and the cooler fins of the hydraulic unit. A hot ambient raises the oil temperature.

Spindle temperature rising fast: The temperature rose by more than 5 °C within 15 minutes at a constant speed. Reduce the speed and watch the trend. Check the lubrication state of the bearings at the next stop.
Chuck not clamped: The clamp sensor reports no clamped state at the program start. Check the jaw stroke and the sensor position.
Emergency stop active: An emergency stop button is pressed. Release it and acknowledge.
Coolant pump motor overload: The motor protection of the coolant pump tripped. Check the pump for chips and the filter basket.
Door lock fault: The door lock did not reach its position. Check the lock and the door alignment.
Coolant level critical: The coolant level is below 10 %. The coolant pump stops to protect itself from dry running. Fill the tank and acknowledge the alarm.
Door open in automatic mode: The guard door was opened while a program ran in auto mode. Close the door and restart the program from the last block.
Grease reservoir low: The grease reservoir is below 20 %. Refill grease NLGI class 00.
Hydraulic oil level low: The level switch reports a low level. Add oil ISO VG 32 and look for leaks.
Coolant temperature high: The coolant is above 35 °C. Thermal growth of the workpiece can affect the size. Check the tank level; consider a coolant chiller in summer.
Chip conveyor overload: The conveyor stopped because of a jam. Run the conveyor backwards for 5 s, remove the jam, and restart.
Lubrication fault: The central lubrication pump built no pressure in 3 cycles in a row. Check the grease reservoir and the pump. Do not run the axes without lubrication for more than 1 hour.
Coolant level low: The coolant level is below 25 %. Add coolant at a concentration of 6 to 8 % before the end of the shift.
Turret indexing timeout: The indexing took longer than 2 s. Check the turret motor and the clamping.
Software limit switch: The program moves an axis outside its stroke. Correct the program or the work offset.
Axis reference lost: The absolute position was lost (encoder battery). Replace the encoder battery and reference the axis.
Cabinet overtemperature: The cabinet temperature is above 50 °C. The drives stop to protect the electronics. Find the cause before the restart.
X axis following error: The X axis deviates more than allowed from its path. Check for a collision and for chips on the guide covers.

statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Dry running: no flow and low motor current. The pump stops. Check that the suction valve is open and that the suction tank has liquid. Vent the casing before the restart.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Suction pressure low. Risk of cavitation. Check the suction strainer and the suction tank level. Do not throttle the suction valve.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Vibration trip (zone D). The pump stops. Do not restart before the cause is found.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Flow below the minimum continuous flow. Open the discharge valve or the bypass. Long operation below 35 m³/h overheats the pump.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Vibration high (zone C). Check the alignment, the foundation bolts, and the impeller for blockage or wear. Plan a repair.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Seal leakage. A steady leak means the mechanical seal is worn: replace it at the next stop.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Bearing temperature trip. The pump stops. Let it cool down. Inspect the bearing before the restart.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Bearing temperature high. Check the grease quantity (too much grease also causes heat) and the alignment. Plan a bearing check.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Standby. The pump is ready and starts on demand. No action.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Motor overload. The motor protection tripped. Check the flow (a flow far above 140 m³/h overloads the motor) and the impeller for blockage.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Discharge pressure trip. The pump stops above 8.0 bar to protect the pipes. Find the closed valve before the restart.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Sensor fault. A sensor signal is outside 4 to 20 mA. Check the cable and the sensor. The related protection is not active.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Discharge pressure high. A valve in the discharge pipe is closed or the system is blocked. Check the valves.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Too many starts. More than 6 starts in 1 hour. Check the pressure switch settings and the demand.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Liquid temperature high. The liquid is above 60 °C. Check the cooling circuit. EPDM seal parts age fast above 70 °C.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Maintenance due. The operating hours reached a maintenance interval of chapter 9.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Running. The pump runs normally.

statusDefinitionDrafts.source_location: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump > 8 Alarm Codes of the HPC-2 Controller
statusDefinitionDrafts.description: Phase failure. One motor phase is missing. Check the fuses and the supply.
Standby. Cause: Pressure above the setpoint, compressor stopped by the VSD logic. Action: No action. The compressor restarts on demand.
Remote stop. Cause: Stopped by the master controller or a remote input. Action: No action.
Loaded. Cause: The compressor delivers air. Action: No action.
Ambient temperature high. Cause: The room is above 46 °C; the speed is reduced. Action: Check the room ventilation and the cooling air outlet duct.
Ambient temperature low. Cause: The room is below 2 °C; condensate can freeze. Action: Heat the room. Do not start below 0 °C.

Element outlet temperature low. Cause: Below 70 °C for more than 2 hours (low load, cold room, thermostatic valve stuck open). Action: Check the thermostatic valve. Water in the oil shortens the oil life.
Temperature sensor fault. Cause: The element outlet sensor is open or short. Action: Check the sensor and the cable.
Element outlet temperature high. Cause: Dirty oil cooler, low oil level, high ambient temperature. Action: Clean the cooler with compressed air from the fan side. Check the oil level.
Oil separator pressure drop high. Cause: The separator element is clogged. Action: Replace the separator element at the next stop.
Element outlet temperature too high. Cause: As W2010, or a faulty thermostatic valve. Action: Let the compressor cool down. Check the oil level and the thermostatic valve before the restart.
Air filter pressure drop high. Cause: The air filter is dirty. Action: Replace the air filter element.
Oil filter pressure drop high. Cause: The oil filter is clogged. Action: Replace the oil filter.
Vessel pressure too high. Cause: Blocked separator element or minimum pressure valve. Action: Replace the separator element. Check the minimum pressure valve.
Phase failure. Cause: One supply phase is missing. Action: Check the fuses and the supply.
Motor overload. Cause: Mechanical blockage, high discharge pressure, voltage drop. Action: Check the supply voltage and turn the air end by hand. Call Norrlund service if it is stiff.
Converter fault. Cause: Converter overtemperature or internal fault. Action: Check the cabinet fan and the filter mat. Read the converter fault code.
Converter temperature high. Cause: Heat sink above 80 °C. Action: Clean the cabinet filter mat. Check the room temperature.
Emergency stop. Cause: The emergency stop button is pressed. Action: Release the button and reset the controller.
Discharge pressure low. Cause: Air demand higher than the delivery, leak in the network. Action: Check the network for leaks. Consider a second compressor.
Undervoltage. Cause: Supply voltage below 340 V. Action: Check the supply. The compressor restarts automatically when the voltage returns (if auto restart is on).
Discharge pressure too high. Cause: Faulty pressure sensor, blocked outlet valve. Action: Check the outlet valve and the pressure sensor.
Condensate drain fault. Cause: The drain valve is blocked or has no power. Action: Clean the drain strainer and test the drain with the test button. Water in the air network damages tools.
Pressure sensor fault. Cause: The pressure sensor signal is outside 4 to 20 mA. Action: Check the sensor and the cable.
Service A due. Cause: Running hours reached 2,000 h since the last service A. Action: Do service A (sheet Service plan) and reset the counter.
Service C due. Cause: Running hours reached 8,000 h since the last service C. Action: Do service C and reset the counter.
Service B due. Cause: Running hours reached 4,000 h since the last service B. Action: Do service B and reset the counter.
Oil life reached. Cause: 2 years since the last oil change, also when the hours are not reached. Action: Change the oil.
Wrong direction of rotation. Cause: Detected at the first start after a supply change (fixed speed fan). Action: Swap two supply phases.
